heading: Today
text: Dense river valley fog burning off. Sun, mixing with afternoon clouds south.

heading: Saturday Night
text: Showers, mostly after midnight, from the Hudson and Champlain Valleys east, scattered west.

heading: Sunday
text: Early showers east and south. A glimpse of sun. Scattered afternoon showers north.

heading: Monday
text: A spotty shower north, then partly to mostly sunny.
